title: use-after-free in signaldict_repr after deletion
object: traps->flags, a borrowed pointer INTO the context object's storage
lifetime_ender: context_clear releases the context without clearing the signal dict's interior pointer, and the signal dict survives it
shape: dangling pointer parked in a surviving object
distinguishing: the gap is unbounded. Every other case's stale access happens inside the operation that created it or on the next API call; this one waits for a repr() that may never come
live_proof: back-patched into the 3.13 branch after v3.13.7
